messages.subject: Sparse Matrix Support
messages.body_plain:
Hi pbdR Users,

I'm new to the package and am trying to figure out if sparse matrices are supported. I see there is a pbdSBASE github page which seems to contain distributed sparse matrix classes. The readme refers users to the pbdDMAT package, but I don't see any references to sparse matrices in the documentation there. Are sparse matrices currently supported?

Thanks
